description.en: Separate Box.into_inner private prototype execution evidence from the later active Ready plus Box compiler build; preserve allocation, ownership and zero-size sanitizer limits.
description.ko: Box.into_inner 비공개 시안 실행 증거와 이후 Ready 및 Box 통합 컴파일러 빌드를 구분하고 할당, 소유권, 크기 0 정리 검사 경계를 보존한다.

contract.ownership: Consume one complete owned Box<T>, move the exact T payload to the result, and release only the outer allocation exactly once. The returned owner is responsible for payload Drop.
contract.supported_payloads: Preserve the inhabited sized payload domain already accepted by Box.new; do not introduce a new Function-only exclusion or new unsafe callback support.
contract.unsized: Direct Box<dyn Interface> extraction is rejected; this does not reject an outer Box whose sized payload is itself a Box<dyn Interface>.
contract.loans: Preserve external payload reference loans, retained exclusive loans and hidden TaskScope provenance after stripping only the logical outer Box payload prefix.
unchanged: Box.new, Box.into_dyn, Box.as_ref and Box.as_mut behavior and storage ABI
Ordinary projected field moves and custom Drop field-move restrictions
Allocation failure preserves accepted input according to existing Box.new contracts
contract.air: BoxExtract is appended to the opcode enumeration. Shared exact-shape validation is used by strict AIR validation, BorrowChecker, ThreadSafetyAnalysis and LLVM generation. Extraction requires a fresh hidden whole-owner local immediately initialized before the operation.

private_prototype.boundary: Ignored isolated compiler and matching library; these execution results do not establish execution success of the later active compiler.
private_prototype.negative_policy: Rejected sources were checked only and were never executed.

fixtures: cross-module inferred Box return followed by inferred Box.into_inner

fault_stages.0: Both allocations succeed: attempts=2, frees=2, live=0.
fault_stages.1: First allocation fails: attempts=1, frees=0, live=0; the retained unboxed payload is dropped once.
fault_stages.2: Second allocation fails: attempts=2, frees=1, live=0; the retained inner Box is extracted and its payload is dropped once.

private_prototype.sanitizer: Actual emitted LLVM received sanitize_address attributes; instrumented objects were checked for __asan_report_ references. AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer used halt_on_error=1. detect_leaks=0 means this is not LeakSanitizer coverage; fault hooks independently require live allocation count zero.

zero_size_sanitizer_boundary.observation: All four retained raw-LLVM cases fail under ASan O0 and pass under O1/O2, including unchanged Box.new(unit) and Box.new(Array<i32,0>) baselines without extraction. Ordinary extraction AOT/JIT O0/O2 passes.
zero_size_sanitizer_boundary.diagnostic: AddressSanitizer: DEADLYSIGNAL; nested bug in the same thread, aborting.
zero_size_sanitizer_boundary.scope: Zero-size scalars and an empty-capture Task closure are tested with ASan O1/O2. Other selected accepted fixtures retain O0/O2 sanitizer coverage. No production LLVM zero-byte rewrite or performance optimization was applied.

active_integration.approval: Approved feature and CMake delta application after the independent minimal inference and final 70-mode private gate.

limits: The canonical Box catalog still contains other unresolved contracts; this checkpoint adds one whole-owner extraction primitive.
No new cross-platform execution, all-library completion or performance improvement is claimed.
